The images show the selected checking state and open availability menu at 1440x1000 and 390x844 in light and dark themes. No clipping or horizontal overflow is visually apparent within those captured states; document-width measurements belong to the separate DOM record.

No Create or Send action, server dispatch, native model execution, live-push delivery, Retry transition, or API acceptance is established by this visual review. The separate HTTP and unit-test evidence retain their own source/version and provenance.
No quantitative contrast, screen-reader, keyboard navigation or additional viewport audit was performed.
